name: Medicine
overview: Scripture reveals that God is sovereign over both sickness and healing, as He wounds and binds up according to His divine purpose (Job 5:18). Physical ailments are acknowledged as real and serious, with references to wounds and sores that require care and ointment (Isaiah 1:6; Isaiah 38:21). The Bible also recognizes the value of medicine and physicians, questioning the absence of healing when balm and physicians are available (Jeremiah 8:22; Jeremiah 30:13). Additionally, healing encompasses more than the physical, as a joyful heart is likened to medicine, while a broken spirit harms the body (Proverbs 17:22), pointing to a holistic understanding of health in Scripture.
